_comment: Voice script. Generated to public/assets/audio/voice/<id>.mp3 by tools/generate-voice.mjs (ElevenLabs). The game shows `text` as subtitles. Story lines stay within docs/NARRATIVE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md beats; no new revelations.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mars, twenty forty-three. Ten years after the first crew arrived, you are the second astronaut to come. The outpost they built is waiting. So are the questions they left behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pressure equalised. Welcome to the outpost.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Outpost check-in received. Rover R-1 last reported from the plain, about one point four kilometres east. Find it, and pull its log.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: That log doesn't match the official report. DRL-2 was never supposed to have run. Restart the drill and bring us that core.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: R-1 is responding to manual control. Keep it off slopes steeper than twenty-eight degrees, and watch the battery.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hydrogen, deep under the dust. And below it, a hollow the radar can't see into. The record says nothing about it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: First sample logged. Every mineral out here is a page of Mars's history, and a resource for whoever stays.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An opening in the escarpment, and survey beacons. Someone came this way, and never wrote it down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Light levels falling. Switch on your suit lamp.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Water ice. Layer upon layer of it, sealed under the mesa for longer than there have been people to look. This changes everything about staying.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Transmission received. Water, in quantity, within reach of the outpost. We need everything you have on how they found it, and why it was never reported.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Oxygen below thirty percent. Head back to the airlock, or use a canister.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Welcome, Expedition Two. Ten years ago, humanity established its first permanent research outpost on Mars. Your assignment is to continue their work, restore the existing settlement, and investigate the planet's potential for long-term human habitation. Several scientific objectives remain unfinished. Your primary responsibilities include habitat maintenance, rover operations, environmental monitoring, and geological exploration. All mission systems are prepared. Destination: Mars.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, this is Mission Control. You are now approaching the final stage of your interplanetary journey. Estimated arrival at Mars is confirmed. All onboard systems are functioning within acceptable parameters. Prepare for orbital insertion.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Mission Control, Expedition Two. Mars is in visual range.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Ten years since the first expedition... Now it's our turn.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, begin atmospheric entry preparations. Confirm heat shield integrity. Confirm landing sequence. All systems are ready.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Copy that. Beginning descent preparations.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Atmospheric entry confirmed. Maintain your descent trajectory. Telemetry is stable.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, we are experiencing signal interference. Continue descent.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Parachute deployment confirmed. Descent velocity decreasing. Prepare for powered landing.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Altitude decreasing. Five hundred meters.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One hundred meters. Contact expected.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Touchdown confirmed. Welcome to Mars, Expedition Two.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Mission Control... Expedition Two has successfully landed.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: It's beautiful out here.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Welcome to Mars. Your mission begins now.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: According to the navigation system, the research outpost should be somewhere ahead. Let's see what ten years on Mars has done to this place.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Destination reached. Original research outpost identified. Structural integrity: assessment required.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: External airlock detected. Access authorization required.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Airlock cycle completed. Internal atmospheric conditions are within acceptable limits.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Primary electrical distribution is offline. Emergency power is available. Manual activation required.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Emergency power restored. Habitat control systems are now accessible.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, we've detected your habitat connection. Welcome to the settlement.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Initial habitat inspection required. Several facilities require assessment.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Initial assessment completed. Multiple systems require restoration.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Looks like we've got some work to do.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Primary power system identified. Current operational status: standby. Complete a diagnostic assessment before activation.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Diagnostic report generated. Reactor activation authorized.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Several distribution channels are inactive. Restore the designated power connections.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Electrical distribution restored. Essential habitat systems may now be activated.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Water-recycling facility detected. Processing efficiency is below operational requirements.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Water-recycling system operational. Resource monitoring has resumed.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Atmospheric processing system requires inspection. Review oxygen-generation status.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Oxygen-generation system operational. Habitat atmospheric support restored.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: An entire food-production facility. Let's see if we can bring it back.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Food-production modules require restoration. Hydroponic cultivation, fungal cultivation, and nutrient recycling are available for assessment.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Food-production facilities operational. Long-term resource monitoring initiated.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: All designated restoration tasks have been recorded. Final habitat assessment required.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, we've received your restoration report. Your settlement is operational. Excellent work.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: What's Sector C-09?

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Rover maintenance facility identified. Available exploration vehicles detected.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: This should be our primary exploration vehicle. Let's see what condition it's in.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Vehicle diagnostic required.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Electrical, navigation, and scientific instrumentation systems require inspection.

lines.speaker: rover
lines.text: Vehicle initialization complete. Exploration systems online.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Expedition Two beginning first surface survey.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Surface survey completed. Geological data successfully collected. One additional navigation record detected.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: That's strange. Where did these coordinates come from?

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Environmental alert. Severe dust storm approaching the settlement. External operations should be suspended.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: External equipment security required. Return exploration vehicles to protected storage.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Environmental protection protocol available. Prioritize essential habitat functions.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Monitor essential resource production. Maintain stable habitat conditions until the storm passes.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Unidentified archived transmission detected. Source: Expedition One.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Expedition One, private research recording. We've identified something beneath the surface. The readings are unusual. We need to investigate further before sending our final report. Coordinates are being stored in the research archive.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Beneath the surface?

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Long-distance exploration preparation required. Inspect vehicle condition, navigation, communications, and scientific instruments.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: All right. Let's find out what's out there.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Navigation destination confirmed. Proceed to designated survey coordinates.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Survey location reached.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Geological sample collection authorized. Record surface composition and environmental conditions.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Sample successfully catalogued.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Unusual subsurface readings detected. Additional scanning required.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Subsurface anomaly recorded. Data correlation pending.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: This equipment belongs to the first expedition. How long has this been sitting here?

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Archived expedition data recovered. Several records reference underground geological surveys.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Geological formation identified. Subsurface readings indicate a possible underground cavity. Proceed with environmental assessment.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: This is the location from the archived coordinates. Let's take a closer look.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Underground exploration preparation required. Inspect portable lighting, environmental sensors, and geological scanning equipment.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Exploration equipment ready. Underground survey authorized.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Mission Control, Expedition Two. We've entered the underground formation. Visibility is limited, but the structure appears stable.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Underground chamber identified. Environmental survey initiated.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Unusual subsurface signal detected. Deploy geological scanning equipment.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: High hydrogen concentration detected. Additional material identification required.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Hydrogen readings? That could mean several things. We need a closer look.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Significant subsurface anomaly detected. Material composition remains unconfirmed. Proceed to designated scanning location.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: ...No way.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Mission Control... You're going to want to see this.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, go ahead.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: We've found ice. Not just traces. There's a massive deposit beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Please repeat your last transmission.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Confirmed subsurface water ice. Large-scale deposits. Mission Control... I think we've found something important.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Scientific sample collection authorized. Collect a controlled sample for laboratory analysis.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Sample secured. Let's get this back to the lab.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Scientific discovery successfully recorded. Return to the research outpost for laboratory analysis.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, we've received your discovery report. Congratulations. This could be one of the most significant findings of the mission.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Laboratory transfer station identified. Secure the collected geological sample for analysis.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Sample successfully transferred. Laboratory analysis available.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Scientific analysis initiated. Material composition, purity, and geological characteristics will be evaluated.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Water ice confirmed. Sample contains frozen water. Additional environmental sampling recommended to determine the extent and distribution of the deposit.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: So it's real. There's water beneath this surface.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Previous expedition records detected. Multiple geological surveys reference subsurface anomalies.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: They were looking for this. They already had evidence. But why didn't they finish the investigation?

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Available geological records can be combined. Reconstruct the previous expedition's underground survey.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Research reconstruction completed. Several potential ice-bearing geological regions identified.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Long-range communication system available. Transmit the verified scientific discovery.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, we have received your findings. Your discovery is significant. We're forwarding the information to the scientific review team. Continue the investigation and preserve all original research records.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Undocumented research facility identified. Architecture and equipment signatures correspond to Expedition One.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: This has to be the place. Let's see what they left behind.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Auxiliary power unavailable. Research archive inaccessible. Restore the designated facility systems.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Research archive accessible.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Multiple archived geological records detected. Recover and synchronize the available research files.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: They found the same readings. They knew there was something beneath this region.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Final expedition recording recovered. Recording date: twenty thirty-five.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Our latest geological survey indicates the presence of significant subsurface ice deposits. We have confirmed that the region contains frozen water. However, our current survey equipment cannot establish the full extent of the deposits. We recommend further exploration and additional sampling.

lines.speaker: researcher
lines.text: Our investigation remains incomplete.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: They weren't hiding some impossible discovery. They simply never finished documenting it.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Original survey records recovered. Current Expedition Two observations available. Combine available data to produce a consolidated geological assessment.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Geological assessment completed. Confirmed water ice deposits documented. Additional exploration recommended.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: Final mission assessment required. Compile environmental, geological, and settlement data.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, your findings have been received. Your work has provided new evidence of Mars' potential for future human settlement. We are awaiting your final recommendation.

lines.speaker: pda
lines.text: All primary mission objectives have been recorded. Final assessment available.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Expedition Two, your final report has been received. Humanity has waited a long time for a discovery like this. We need your recommendation.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: Expedition Two, final log. Ten years ago, humanity came here to discover whether Mars could become our second home. Today, we've found another reason to keep looking.

lines.speaker: astronaut
lines.text: There's still so much we don't understand. Until the next expedition... End of transmission.
